messages:
support_jess: FYI customer ACME (ticket #12345) says their invoice shows ~1.8M tokens for Feb but dashboard shows ~1.2M. They point to the 02/10 eventstore outage window. Can we triage?
eng_oncall_mike: On it. Which pipeline - metering ingestion or ledger?
support_jess: Metering ingestion primarily, but billing team says invoice ledger disagrees with public dashboard. Customer asking for explanation + repro steps.
replay-bot: backfill-job 2026-02-10-ACME queued -> RUNNING -> ERROR: "dedupe-window-exceeded" at 2026-02-10T11:07:34Z. See /replays/2026-02-10/2026-02-10-ACME for logs.
dataeng_ravi: I sketched quick root cause: during the outage events sat in eventstore >48h. The dedupe worker prunes events older than dedupe TTL=48h before replay, so many original metering events were dropped by the replay path. Billing ledger consumed from primary delivery stream when it came back, which included some events the dashboard pipeline missed, and the backfill failed -> mismatch.
sre_anna: That explains the token delta. Dashboard = ingested after dedupe pruning, Ledger = persisted delivery + some late handoffs.
eng_oncall_mike: Can we re-run the replay with dedupe disabled? What's the risk of double-billing?
billing_luis: If we re-run w/ disable-dedupe, we risk emitting duplicate metering events into ledger which could inflate invoice. We need a reconciliation run to compute idempotency and deltas before adding to billing. Provisional credit for ACME ASAP.
pm_claire: Customer-facing exec: propose provisional credit of $12,000 while we reconcile. I'll draft the note. Need ETA from eng on replay timeline.
sre_anna: Plan: 1) snapshot current ledger + dashboard counts; 2) run replay dry-run to compute candidate extra-token footprint (no writes) using `./replay_tool run --job 2026-02-10-ACME --dry-run --disable-dedupe`; 3) review delta with billing; 4) if OK, run live replay with de-dup safety: `--idempotency-check=soft` and billing guard rails.
replay-bot: dry-run started (job-id dry-2026-02-10-ACME). ETA ~20m. Logs: `TRACE: scanned 1,976,432 events, candidate_tokens=652,341, skipped=1,023,112`
dataeng_ravi: Quick repro steps I used: 1) query eventstore for ACME between 2026-02-10T02:00Z and 2026-02-10T08:00Z: `SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE customer='ACME' AND ts >= '2026-02-10' AND ts < '2026-02-11'`; 2) compare to ledger table `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing_events WHERE job_tag='2026-02-10-ACME'`; 3) diff shows ledger > dashboard by ~600k tokens.
eng_oncall_mike: Dry-run results in. Replay-bot: `candidate_tokens=652341, risk_duplicate_tokens=0 if we use idempotency markers, risk_nonrecoverable=high if we re-enable writes without dedupe`. Ravi, can you run a targeted reingest of the missing window to a staging ledger so billing can run recon scripts?
dataeng_ravi: Yep. I'll spin a staging replay: `./replay_tool run --job 2026-02-10-ACME --target=staging-ledger --disable-dedupe --dry-run=false` — will post staging counts when done.
billing_luis: Once staging counts are up we run `scripts/recon_metering.py --ledger staging-ledger --dashboard ACME-feb` to compute delta. If delta ~652k tokens, we issue provisional credit and then decide on live ingest.
pm_claire: Customer comms drafted. I'll hold until billing confirms provisional credit.
sre_anna: Note: we should add a safelist window for future backfills so events held by upstream outages > dedupe TTL aren't dropped automatically. Filed a follow-up: infra-#456.
eng_oncall_mike: Owners: SRE Anna (run staging replay and validate), DataEng Ravi (run staging job + reconciliation), Billing Luis (approve credit + final calc), PM Claire (customer comms). ETA for staging results: 2 hours.
support_jess: Thanks all — I'll keep the customer updated with Claire's note and the provisional credit plan. Please @channel when staging results land. :thumbsup:
replay-bot: staging replay finished. staging-ledger tokens = 1,852,241, dashboard tokens = 1,199,892, delta = 652,349. Dry-run logs archived at /replays/staging/2026-02-10-ACME/logs.
billing_luis: Confirm delta ~652,349 tokens => provisional credit $11,875 issued to ACME. I'll follow up with full reconciliation and invoice adj in 72h.
pm_claire: Sent customer note with credit reference and ETA for reconciliation. ACME acknowledged and appreciates the quick response.
sre_anna: Closing this incident's active triage. Follow-ups: infra-#456 (dedupe safelist) and ops-#789 (improve replay monitoring/alerts).
eng_oncall_mike: Thanks everyone. Marking as resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
